info.title: Attn. Creator Profile API
info.description: Pay-per-access creator and professional profiles via x402 nanopayments on Arc Network. Any AI agent can pay $0.001 USDC to unlock a creator's full profile. Built on Circle Gateway GatewayWalletBatched settlement with real EIP-3009 verification.

get.description:
Returns a creator or professional's full profile. Requires a valid x402 EIP-3009 payment signature for $0.001 USDC on Arc Testnet. Signed-in Attn. users receive free access. External AI agents must pay via the x402 protocol.

**Payment flow:**
1. Call this endpoint without a payment header
2. Receive HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 encoded GatewayWalletBatched requirements)
3. Decode the requirements and sign an EIP-3009 payment authorization for $0.001 USDC to the seller wallet
4. Re-call with the payment-signature header containing the base64 encoded signed authorization
5. Receive HTTP 200 with full profile JSON

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: The creator's unique handle registered on Attn.

parameters.name: payment-signature
parameters.description: Base64 encoded EIP-3009 signed payment authorization. Required for external agents. Omit to receive the 402 payment challenge.

200.description: Payment verified. Full creator profile returned.

PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: Base64 encoded payment settlement confirmation from Circle Gateway

profile.bio: I am the founder of Attnn and a full stack developer

402.description: Payment required. Returns x402 payment challenge with GatewayWalletBatched requirements.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64 encoded x402 payment requirements including amount, asset, network, and seller wallet

500.description: Payment processing error (e.g. invalid payment signature)

get.description: Returns a public HTML page listing all active creators registered on Attn. No payment required. Shows handle and minimum bid only full profile details require visiting the individual creator profile page.

bio.example: Full stack developer and Web3 builder

minBid.description: Minimum bid amount in USDC atomic units (6 decimals). Divide by 1,000,000 for USD value.

isActive.description: Whether the creator is currently accepting bids

payer.description: Who paid for access. 'x402' for external agents, 'authenticated-user' for signed-in users.

PaymentRequired.description: The PAYMENT-REQUIRED header contains a base64 encoded JSON object with x402Version, resource, and accepts fields. The accepts array contains GatewayWalletBatched payment requirements: scheme (exact), network (eip155:5042002 = Arc Testnet), asset (0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000 = USDC on Arc), amount (1000 = $0.001 USDC), payTo (platform seller wallet), and verifyingContract (Circle Gateway contract).

x402Payment.name: payment-signature
x402Payment.description: Base64 encoded EIP-3009 signed payment authorization for $0.001 USDC on Arc Testnet (eip155:5042002) via Circle Gateway GatewayWalletBatched. Generate by signing the payment requirements returned in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header of a 402 response.
